title: Worm One
description: Watch a rule-driven worm trace a visual pattern.
versionOrder: Four consecutive tape3a saves. Inferred development order follows save order and additions to the grid bookkeeping and starting-position input. Source credit is July 27, 1980; this does not date every save.

versions.label: WORM ONE
versions.note: Untouched recovered save. 33 consistent BASIC line pointers; normal end marker; byte-identical with left-hp800, right-boosted, left-hp1600; not execution-tested
versions.unavailableReason: Source only. The site plays one selected best version; this save is preserved for comparison.
